controls.tool_permissions: Same testcase-specific tool policy and runner catalog for both rules.
controls.execution_environment: Runtime is recorded per raw run, but the host/Python environment is not pinned across future sessions.
controls.scorer: Shared scorer implementation; experiment-specific paths and labels are supported.

blockers.evidence: experiment.json model_parameters.model_id is null; select and pin one model ID before any model request.
experiment.json model_parameters.reasoning_effort is null; choose one setting and hold it constant for both rules and all repeats.
The runner records Python version, platform, and its own source hash per raw run, but no execution image/runtime lock is defined.
The runner commits, pushes, and reads back raw run/index files from origin/main; this experiment-specific path has only been statically checked and not exercised with a run.
No real API request has been made; credentials must be supplied only as an environment variable on the execution host after configuration is pinned.
